trainMF: returns one finite history row per epoch
selectBestCheckpoint: smallest valRMSE wins, ties keep the earliest epoch
recommendTopK: excludes train+val items but allows test-rated items
recallAtK: relevant movie at rank 1 scores 1.0; at rank 11 scores 0.0
recallAtK: empty test set returns 0 without dividing by zero
